records.FullPageBody: Today’s New Moon in {{eventSign}} can make a new desire, relationship term, purchase, or value feel worth exploring before you know where it leads. Venus helps you notice what you want; the New Moon gives you permission to learn from the wanting instead of turning it into a promise.

records.FullPageBody: Today’s Full Moon across {{eventSign}} and {{oppositeSign}} shows what the current arrangement is actually giving back. Venus can name what feels good, beautiful, loving, or worthwhile; the Full Moon makes the imbalance harder to hide when the time, money, affection, or compromise has not been mutual.

records.FullPageBody: Today’s Solar Eclipse in {{eventSign}} can make attraction, possibility, or a new agreement feel larger than its evidence. Venus may be ready to say yes, but eclipse beginnings can change shape quickly; notice what the choice asks you to value before locking in the terms.

records.FullPageBody: Today’s Lunar Eclipse across {{eventSign}} and {{oppositeSign}} can expose what a relationship, financial choice, or belief about worth has been costing to maintain. Venus still describes what you want to preserve; the eclipse shows what no longer holds just because you cared about it.
